status: exploratory hypotheses, no causal discovery established

hypotheses.name: Sentence restart after boundary
hypotheses.evidence: Cluster2 exemplars end at newline/sentence boundaries.
hypotheses.discriminator: Match current boundary token; vary whether sentence ended; measure next-token start distribution and residual edits.

hypotheses.name: Clause-completion punctuation readiness
hypotheses.evidence: Cluster3 often precedes punctuation at completed clauses.
hypotheses.discriminator: Same final lexical token in complete versus incomplete clause; test punctuation probability and causal swaps.

hypotheses.name: Determiner-to-noun continuation
hypotheses.evidence: Cluster7 includes determiner/noun-phrase contexts.
hypotheses.discriminator: Hold final determiner fixed across predicted noun categories; compare residual versus token-only effects.

hypotheses.name: Within-word continuation
hypotheses.evidence: Cluster5 includes partial-looking strings and suffix predictions.
hypotheses.discriminator: Separate token-internal continuation from new-word boundaries, matching current BPE token where possible.

hypotheses.name: Coordination and list continuation
hypotheses.evidence: Cluster1 includes an anatomical list.
hypotheses.discriminator: Parallel items versus completed list with same conjunction; validate on several semantic domains.

hypotheses.name: Prepositional argument completion
hypotheses.evidence: Cluster4 contains from/at/into contexts.
hypotheses.discriminator: Match final preposition and manipulate expected argument type; use neutral-topic controls.

hypotheses.name: Discourse connective continuation
hypotheses.evidence: Cluster0 includes but/as continuations.
hypotheses.discriminator: Compare connective uses with same token in other constructions; test completion distributions.

hypotheses.name: Entity-category expectation
hypotheses.evidence: Some contexts predict person/place/object continuations.
hypotheses.discriminator: Hold formatting and current token fixed while changing entity-category cues.

hypotheses.name: Domain-specific vocabulary state
hypotheses.evidence: Cluster1 medical examples may share lexical domain.
hypotheses.discriminator: Cross topic and syntax factorially; test whether effects follow domain or syntactic position.

hypotheses.name: Heading/list formatting state
hypotheses.evidence: Cluster5 includes headings and list-like fragments.
hypotheses.discriminator: Compare identical content in prose, headings and lists; examine continuation format.

hypotheses.name: Delimiter closure state
hypotheses.evidence: Not established by current exemplars; plausible residual function.
hypotheses.discriminator: Fresh matched quotation/bracket-open versus closed contexts, with length controls.

hypotheses.name: Local morphology constraints
hypotheses.evidence: Word fragments may encode suffix compatibility.
hypotheses.discriminator: Use token-valid inflection/derivation pairs with lexical and boundary controls; avoid existing tense holdout training.

hypotheses.name: Prediction uncertainty
hypotheses.evidence: Residual clusters may mostly track entropy.
hypotheses.discriminator: Stratify by native entropy and test whether cluster patterns persist within strata.

hypotheses.name: Unexpected-continuation state
hypotheses.evidence: Residual structure may track local surprisal.
hypotheses.discriminator: Compare continuation surprisal at matched token/position; avoid using future tokens for fitting.

hypotheses.name: Current-token identity artifact
hypotheses.evidence: Cluster2 mode is period; others mix many tokens.
hypotheses.discriminator: Exact-token matched controls and token-conditioned subtraction on discovery data only.

hypotheses.name: Absolute position artifact
hypotheses.evidence: Four fixed positions can induce clusters.
hypotheses.discriminator: Report cluster occupancy by position and replicate at new predeclared positions.

hypotheses.name: Residual-norm/outlier artifact
hypotheses.evidence: Spherical fitting removes magnitude but raw direction may still correlate with norm.
hypotheses.discriminator: Norm-matched strata and robust removal of predeclared extreme-norm states.

hypotheses.name: Document/style/boilerplate artifact
hypotheses.evidence: Four states per document share source context.
hypotheses.discriminator: Document-block resampling and new-document replication; count independent documents.

hypotheses.name: Task-span domain shift
hypotheses.evidence: Task PCA leaves large natural residual.
hypotheses.discriminator: Compare train-only natural PCA and task PCA on separate pilot documents with downstream fidelity.

hypotheses.name: Clusters are quantization, not natural units
hypotheses.evidence: Finite8-way clustering imposes categories.
hypotheses.discriminator: Compare continuous subspace prediction and multiple cluster counts on discovery only; require causal selectivity before naming units.
